finding.mechanism: The active accelerator prompt advertised ready_for_forge=true in the same machine-readable skeleton that set patch_unified_diff to an empty string. Evidence Forge admits ready=true candidates for evaluation but returns needs_implementation when patch, target files or tests are absent/safety-invalid. The prompt therefore supplied a contradictory exemplar at exactly the worker-to-Forge boundary.

delta: make the machine-readable skeleton explicitly ready_for_forge=false while executable fields are empty
state that ready_for_forge=true requires non-empty mutually consistent target_files, an actual applicable unified diff, non-empty test_commands and a concrete falsifier
forbid labeling an empty patch as Forge-ready
add a focused deterministic source/mechanism regression for the prompt contract
